description: WiFi public extérieur à Nantes Métropole is a dataset listed in Open Data Nantes Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Nantes Métropole. Bornes d'accès au Wifi en extérieur mises en place sur le territoire de Nantes Métropole Le réseau de Wifi public gratuit de Nantes Métropole s'appelle « Nantes Wifi Public ». En extérieur, il est désormais accessible sur 44 sites et sur 3 lignes de transports publics. D’autres sites seront proposés dans les prochains mois. Coverage: Nantes Métropole. The portal files it under Territoires. Its keywords are aménagement urbain, numérique, connexion, hotspot, accessibilité, réseau. The portal shows 44 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nantesmetropole-fr-portal.
